changelog.text: Confirmed Delta Sky Clubs at Jacksonville (Concourse A), Memphis (Concourse B) and Milwaukee (Concourse D), plus a Sky Club (Concourse C) and Escape Lounge (Concourse B) at Palm Beach. All were found by the nightly airport-website scan.
Added from airport websites: DJT: Delta Sky Club; DJT: Escape Lounge; JAX: Delta Sky Club; MEM: Delta Sky Club; MKE: Delta Sky Club.
Airports with no lounges now say so plainly. The app knows all 645 US airports with scheduled flights and which ones have Priority Pass lounges.

Guest rules by age added for every lounge network: infants under 2 are free at Centurion, Capital One, Sapphire, Sky Club, United Club and Alaska lounges; enter your guests on the trip form to see costs and limits.

Added Star Alliance partner lounges (Air Canada Maple Leaf at LAX, LGA, SFO and EWR; Star Alliance Lounge at LAX), open to Star Alliance Gold on any Star flight including domestic United, and to United Club All Access members. All Access now shows 2 guests.

Delta and American checked against their own sites: Sky Clubs now open to members and Amex cardholders on arrival; Delta Medallion vs. partner SkyTeam status handled separately; oneworld status from non-American airlines works on domestic flights; Sapphire and Emerald status now shows Flagship Lounges on international trips; JFK Flagship removed (it's now the Chelsea Lounge).
United Clubs now show as open to members and United Club cardholders when you're arriving, not just departing.

Added every US Priority Pass lounge (60 venues at 36 airports) so results name them instead of linking out; added Amex partner lounges (Escape, Plaza Premium) and missing lounges at Kansas City, Dallas and Atlanta.

Checked all networks. Centurion card guests now include family; Polaris partner list adds ITA and Brussels; Star Alliance Gold guests must be on your flight; Delta One Basic fares lose access Jan 19, 2027 (notice); updated guest rules for Admirals, Alaska and Flagship; fixed Sapphire, Delta One and SFO lounge locations, added the IAD Etihad/Sapphire lounge, marked the SFO Alaska Lounge closed.
Rules moved to a live data store. Items marked unverified will be checked on the first refresh.
